simple.meaning: עָלַץ (ʻâlats) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to jump for joy , i.e. exult.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 8 times across 1 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Psalms, Proverbs, beginning at 1 Samuel 2:1. Its contexts include righteousness.

definitions.short: to jump for joy , i.e. exult

(rare); Hiph`il Imperfect יעליצו Ecclus 40:20; Assyrian elêƒu , exult ; Sabean מעלץ joys CIS iv, No. 197, 1. 5. 7 ; see also עלס עלז, ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ע בְּי ׳לִבִּי 1Sam 2:1 my heart exulteth in ׳י ; Imperfect 3masculine singular הַשָּׂדֶה יַעֲלֹץ 1Chr 16:32 the field exulteth ; compare 3 feminine singular קִרְיָה תַּעֲלֹץ Prov 11:10 (|| רנן ); 1 singular בָּ֑ךְ אֶעֶלְצָה Psa 9:3 (i.e. in ׳י ; + שׂמח , || זמּר ); 3 masculine plural בְךָ יַעְלְצוּ 5:12 (in ׳י ; || רנן שׂמח, ); אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵי יַעַלְצוּ 68:4 (+ שׂמח , || שׂישׂ ); + לִי 25:2 exult at me; Infinitive construct בַּעֲלֹץ Prov 28:12 when the righteous exult .

occurrences.englishText: Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
For you will bless the righteous.
My God, I have trusted in you.
Sing to God! Sing praises to his name!
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices.
When the righteous triumph, there is great glory;
